name: ZC & ZS Carry Quintile Analysis
description: Quintile sort on carry (cont.carry) for Corn (ZC) and Soybeans (ZS) futures. Rank 1 = deepest contango, Rank 5 = deepest backwardation. Uses full expanding-history percentrank for equal-population quintile boundaries. Shows avg 63-day forward carry (carry << 63) and hit rate (% of observations where forward carry is positive) by quintile. Summary table includes obs count, avg carry, avg forward carry, and hit rate per quintile. NoAdjustment for carry integrity.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ZC & ZS CARRY QUINTILE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
#
# Quintile sort on cont.carry (M1/M2 term structure signal):
#   Rank 1 = deepest contango (carry most negative)
#   Rank 5 = deepest backwardation (carry most positive)
#
# Quintile method: percentrank over full expanding history → equal-population
#   buckets regardless of carry distribution shape (S44: no z-score thresholds).
#
# Forward carry: carry << 63 (lead operator, NOT forward_returns — S46 trap:
#   forward_returns divides by carry which crosses zero → inf values).
#
# Hit rate: ternary 1/0 (NOT where(cond, 1.0) which gives 100% always — S41).
#
# NoAdjustment: preserves real carry levels (BackwardPanamaCanal distorts
#   cross-contract price differences over long histories).
# =============================================================================

# --- Primary asset: ZC or ZS (market_data_source binds to each asset) ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

carry = cont.carry

# --- Forward carry: value of carry 63 trading days ahead ---
# Use lead operator (<<), NOT forward_returns() which divides by carry
# and produces inf when carry crosses zero (S46).
fwd_carry = carry << 63

# --- Hit rate: 1 if forward carry is positive, 0 otherwise ---
# Guard with is_valid() to handle NaN at the tail of the series (S02).
# Use ternary (NOT where(cond, 1.0)) to avoid S41 trap where Mean = 100%.
hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_carry) and fwd_carry > 0) else 0.0

# --- Quintile assignment via expanding percentrank ---
# percentrank(period=0) is not supported; use a very large period to approximate
# full history. We use cumulative rank approach:
# percentrank returns 0-100; bucket into quintiles 1-5.
# Rank 1 = lowest carry (deepest contango), Rank 5 = highest (deepest backwardation).
pctrank = percentrank(period=5000)(carry)

# Map percentrank (0-100) to quintile 1-5
# Q1: 0-20, Q2: 20-40, Q3: 40-60, Q4: 60-80, Q5: 80-100
quintile = conditional_select(
    pctrank <= 20, 1,
    pctrank <= 40, 2,
    pctrank <= 60, 3,
    pctrank <= 80, 4,
    5
)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table — Quintile × 4 Metrics (RowSpec GROUP BY mode)
# Rows: Obs Count, Avg Carry, Avg Fwd Carry (63d), Hit Rate (%)
# Columns: Q1 (Deepest Contango) → Q5 (Deepest Backwardation)
# groupKey = quintile (1-5, 1-indexed → maps to col_headers positionally)
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Carry Quintile Analysis (Q1=Deepest Contango, Q5=Deepest Backwardation)',
        col_headers=['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'Q5'],
        rows=[
            RowSpec(name='Obs Count', agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            RowSpec(name='Avg Carry', agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            RowSpec(name='Avg Fwd Carry (63d)', agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4,
                    color_map={Color.Success: ['POSITIVE'], Color.Error: ['NEGATIVE']}),
            RowSpec(name='Hit Rate (%)', agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3,
                    color_map={Color.Success: ['POSITIVE'], Color.Error: ['NEGATIVE']})
        ]
    ),
    category='Carry Quintile',
    order=0
)(carry, quintile)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Avg 63-Day Forward Carry by Quintile
# Labeled mode: label=quintile (1-5), values=fwd_carry, agg=Mean
# color_by_value: green=backwardation persists, red=contango persists
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Avg 63-Day Forward Carry by Quintile (Q1=Deepest Contango → Q5=Deepest Backwardation)',
    category='Carry Quintile',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_axis_label='Carry Quintile',
    y_axis_label='Avg Forward Carry (63d)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=fwd_carry, label=quintile)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Hit Rate (% Forward Carry Positive) by Quintile
# Labeled mode: label=quintile (1-5), values=hit, agg=Mean
# hit is 0/1 so Mean = fraction positive; displayed as decimal (0.0-1.0)
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Hit Rate: % of Obs Where 63d Forward Carry Is Positive, by Quintile',
    category='Carry Quintile',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_axis_label='Carry Quintile',
    y_axis_label='Hit Rate (fraction)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50% (Coin Flip)')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=hit, label=quintile)
